conviction_note: Positive lean from company-level order data (Q1 BB 1.18, backlog 174億 = 2.5 months of sales) plus an independent peer series (Yageo Sept 2026 revenue +4.5% m/m, +46% y/y) and a management that has raised at four of the last five prints, against a sector-wide AI/passive-component sell-off (Murata, Taiyo Yuden, ROHM, Yageo all -8 to -11% on 10/15) and a crowded margin long (信用倍率 23.85); the findings sum to +2.2 while the scaled number is +1.44 because p_up is held at 58 for the sector tape and margin overhang, which the findings do not size.
bar: Company H1 guide raised 2026-07-23: sales 43,000m, OP 2,540m, ordinary 3,010m, NP 5,250m (incl. 3,098m relocation gain); FY sales 87,300m, OP 5,360m, ordinary 6,040m, NP 7,740m, dividend 63円 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260722597191.pdf). No 四季報/IFIS consensus reachable (kabutan revision detail is premium, minkabu/irbank unavailable), so the company plan is the only sourced bar and every size is kept modest.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.15% of shares (1 seller), up 0.14pt from 1.01% as of 2026-10-22 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 23.85 (kabutan quote page 2026-10-23): heavily crowded margin long, underwater after a 28% fall from the 2,571 close of 2026-10-06. No options, no skew. Baseline priced_lean_pct +0.68 (run-up component +0.96 offsets margin overhang -0.69).

findings.finding: KOA's own Q1 data showed orders of 246億 against sales of 208.8億 (BB 1.18, highest since FY2021 Q3) and a backlog of 174億 (2.5 months), while the July H1 guide needs only Q2 sales of 221億 and Q2 OP of 16.9億; an independent peer series (Yageo, world's largest chip-resistor maker) shows passive demand still rising through September (Sept 2026 revenue NT$17.07bn, +4.5% m/m, +46% y/y), making an H1 beat and a further FY raise (with an automatic 30%-payout dividend increase) more likely than a hold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: KOA revised FY guidance up at the 2025-07-23, 2025-10-23, 2026-01-28 and 2026-07-23 prints (kabutan 修正履歴); next-session moves +17.3%, +22.2%, -4.5%, +11.6% (baseline history). The 2026-04-24 conservative initial guide drew -11.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen 28% since 2026-10-06 in lockstep with Murata, Taiyo Yuden and ROHM on an AI/semiconductor de-risking (Nikkei -4.9% on 10/15), not on any KOA disclosure; kabutan's 10/18 and 10/22 上方修正期待 screens do not list KOA because its Q1 progress against the already-raised plan looks ordinary (ordinary 21.8%). If the market were pricing a second raise the stock would not trade at PBR 0.75 and ~12x ex-gain earnings after a sector-beta drawdown.
findings.independence: Yageo September 2026 monthly revenue +4.51% m/m, +46.12% y/y (https://winvest.tw/News/Detail/95386, 2026-10-08) — a different company and a different source; y/y is inflated by Yageo's acquisitions, so only the m/m direction is used.

findings.finding: Precious-metal input costs, which KOA's July bridge carried as a 31億 FY headwind (貴金属相場高騰), fell through Q2: silver futures from ~74-76 (Apr-May) to 57.6 (Jul), 60.1 (Sep) and ~54 (Oct); palladium from 1,526 (Apr) to ~1,050 now — i.e. at or below the level the July guide was set at.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 OP rose only 3.5億 y/y because of precious-metal costs (Q1 supplementary p.2); no prior print isolates this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission: the guide already partly reflects July prices and KOA passes some cost through (価格是正), so most of this is inside the guide; what is left is the further decline since July, which helps H2 margin and the odds of a raise. Sized small as a proxy.
findings.independence: KOA July bridge (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260722597196.pdf p.10) names precious metals as the largest cost line; same company document as finding 1 for the bridge, different series for the price.

findings.finding: FX has moved against the July H2 assumption (USD 159, EUR 185): USD/JPY ~156 and EUR/JPY ~175 now, with ~19% of sales in Europe and 16% in North America, which gives management a reason to hold rather than raise the FY plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-10 raise cited a weaker yen; no print where FX alone drove a cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Public FX series, largely visible; small residual on whether it caps the guide revision.

findings.finding: The 3,098m relocation gain on the Taicang subsidiary booked in H1 is explicitly already in the July forecast, so the H1 NP jump (5,250m guide, 4.5x y/y) adds nothing at the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Disclosed 2026-09-15; stock +1.5% next day (2,144 to 2,224), within normal noise.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the document says 織り込み済み. Filed at 0 so the headline NP jump is not read as a surprise.

Cause of the 10/15 and 10/20-23 drop: no KOA-specific news; peers Murata, Taiyo Yuden, ROHM, TDK, Nichicon, Yageo fell together (Yahoo chart data)

KOA price increase (値上げ) announcements 2026: nothing found

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6999&nmode=3 (Q1 短信 and revision stamped 26/07/23 15:30; kabutan 10/22 schedule lists KOA 前回15:30, time unconfirmed)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible upward (raised at 4 of last 5 prints; backlog and peer series strong) but July guide already embeds a Q2 OP doubling and FX has moved against H2; returns: dividend tied to 30% payout so any NP raise lifts it, no buyback history; no new-year guide (H1 print); quarter: Q1 ordinary progress 21.8% of a just-raised plan, Q2 needs 16.9億 OP vs Q1 8.5億.
baseline_tension: Agrees with priced_lean (+0.68) and cuts against the -19% 20-day run-up; the run-up is a sector-beta drawdown with no KOA-specific cause, and the strongest positive the release could carry (FY raise plus payout-linked dividend increase) is what finding 1 sizes; the main risk is that the sector tape and an underwater, crowded margin long overwhelm any print.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 concerns negatives on visible 月次/progress misses (none here; KOA publishes no 月次) and rule 2 concerns a negative tilt (this hunt leans positive and its one negative is a small FX finding), so the draft stands as frozen
